EC1: - Known allergic reaction to components of the study product(s).
EC2: - Uncooperative [OR] or behaviorally unsuited (assessed during a TB prophylaxis at the initial baseline study visit).
EC3: - A sibling of a child already enrolled in the study (the family's oldest child in the eligible age range will be the study child).
EC5: - Anything else that would place him/her at increased health risk [OR] or [NOT] preclude the individual's full compliance with or completion of the study.
